---
title: "Analyzing US Births"
author: "Angel Frias"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
births_tibble |>
  summarize(
    mean_births = mean(births),
    .by = c(month, date_of_month)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    month = factor(month, levels = 12:1, labels = month.abb[12:1])
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = mean_births)) +
  geom_tile(width = 1, height = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:31, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Day of month",
    y = "Month",
    fill = "Mean births"
  )
```

```{r}
christmas_summary <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12) |>
  summarize(
    christmas_births = births[date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    baseline_births = mean(births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]),
    pct_of_baseline = round(100 * christmas_births / baseline_births, 1),
    .by = year
  ) |>
  arrange(year)

christmas_summary |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
christmas_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday",
    title = "Christmas Day births relative to nearby December days"
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(
  births ~ factor(year) + factor(month) + factor(day_of_week),
  data = births_tibble
)

summary(births_model)$r.squared

births_tibble <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(residual = resid(births_model))

births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = 100 * residual / mean(births))

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  summarize(
    mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid),
    .by = c(month, date_of_month)
  ) |>
  mutate(calendar_date = make_date(2001, month, date_of_month)) |>
  arrange(calendar_date)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_dips <- calendar_resid |>
  filter(
    calendar_date %in% make_date(
      2001,
      c(12, 7, 1),
      c(25, 4, 1)
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    holiday = case_when(
      month == 12 & date_of_month == 25 ~ "Christmas",
      month == 7 & date_of_month == 4 ~ "July 4",
      month == 1 & date_of_month == 1 ~ "New Year's Day"
    )
  )

calendar_resid |>
  ggplot(aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_text(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(
      label = holiday,
      hjust = case_when(
        month == 1 ~ 0,
        month == 12 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0.5
      )
    ),
    vjust = -0.8
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  labs(
    x = "Calendar date",
    y = "Mean residual (% of average births)",
    title = "Daily birth residuals across the calendar"
  )
```
